description: This file defines the HelpService class within the OrangeHRM Help plugin. It manages help configurations and processors, providing methods to retrieve redirect URLs and validate URLs.

classes.name: HelpService
classes.description: A service class managing help configurations and processing functions for help-related functionalities within the OrangeHRM Help plugin.

methods.name: getHelpConfigService
methods.description: Returns an instance of HelpConfigService, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: getHelpProcessor
methods.description: Returns an instance of HelpProcessor, instantiating it based on configuration if not already set.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns a URL string to redirect to, based on the provided label, via the HelpProcessor.

methods.name: getDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns a default redirect URL from the HelpProcessor.

methods.name: isValidUrl
methods.description: Validates the base help URL from configuration to ensure it is a valid URL.
